title: ipomoea dalzellii
intro: Ipomoea dalzellii, commonly known as the Dalzell's morning glory, is a species of flowering plant in the family Convolvulaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Ipomoea dalzellii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
